title: mentha × dumetorum var. brachystachya
intro: Mentha × dumetorum var. brachystachya, commonly known as Japanese peppermint, is a variety of hybrid mint plant. It is known for its distinctive peppermint-like aroma and flavor. The health benefits of Japanese peppermint include its ability to alleviate digestive issues, reduce nausea and vomiting, and provide relief from headaches and fever. The bioactive constituents of Japanese peppermint include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects.
